Our server, Jenny, cooked everything at the table for us and guided us through the whole experience. The food was excellent, the atmosphere was great, and the table-side cooking made it feel like a real experience rather than just a meal. Would highly recommend if you’re visiting Ho Chi Minh City and want good Korean BBQ.
